purpose: Anonymous Animagine high-angle guide -> OpenPose plus background-only Canny -> same-base SDXL Mira LoRA structural transfer.

structural_inputs.canny_person_exclusion: OpenPose-localized GrabCut foreground plus safety dilation; anonymous guide hair, clothes, limbs, and face edges are excluded.

human_review.no_structure: Face/outfit-like colors are present, but the requested high-angle composition is absent; candidate is eye-level and therefore fails the camera gate.
human_review.openpose_only: High camera placement is partially transferred, but the running guide pose changes to a seated/crouched pose; fails the action fidelity gate.
human_review.background_canny_only: Background tilt/perspective is partially transferred, but the person is not structurally constrained and the image has a duplicate/split trouser-like silhouette; fails anatomy and pose gates.
human_review.combined_openpose_background_canny: Not generated. The two full SDXL ControlNets terminate during the combined condition at both 768x1152 and 512x768 in the current 8GB sequential-offload diffusers route.

decision: Do not promote this route to an approved production tool. Preserve it as a checkpoint: anonymous high-angle guide separation and background-only Canny extraction work; the current SDXL single-control outputs do not meet pose and identity quality gates, and dual ControlNet is not feasible in this runtime.
